corrections: Derived from the real compiler error pattern and the prior bundle: the root cause is a discrete algebraic/nonlinear system involving Boolean and Integer variables from the controller event logic, not a single syntax line. The repaired controller avoids using edge(startEnable) directly inside the when trigger set more than once and keeps one writer per discrete state variable.

Baseline integration medium remains Modelica.Media.Water.StandardWater exactly as resolved for topology/control validation only; the intended WaterNaCl physical medium is not implemented because the brief does not supply a complete executable medium package here.

P1 and P2 are still represented only by commanded return-branch behavior in the controller and not as physical pump components, because the brief supplies nominal flow and differential pressure but no callable Standard Library pump curve data and earlier attempts using a nonexistent constantFlow characteristic were rejected.

B5/K1 evaporation-condensation physics remain simplified in the prior bundle; no evidence in the brief supplies a complete, unit-verified executable implementation of the stated m_con relation, so this draft preserves baseline topology/control scope only.
